unite_adi: UPPER SECONDARY-YEAR 12 (AFTER PREP)-LEVEL: B2.4 - THEME 7: LIFE IN NATURE & GLOBAL PROBLEMS

bolumler.ogrenmeKanitlari: PERFORMANCE ASSIGNMENT: Students will explore the theme of life in nature and global problems with its sub-themes: natural disaster preparedness, balancing ecosystems, eco-tourism, and responsible travel. For this project, students will prepare a video guide that highlights practical tips for preparing for natural disasters, such as creating emergency kits and evacuation plans. They will also explain the importance of preserving ecosystems to reduce the frequency and impact of such disasters. Additionally, they will show the principles of eco-tourism such as promoting responsible travel habits like minimising waste, supporting local communities, and respecting wildlife. Students are also asked to offer actionable solutions for a more sustainable future with nature. Students will present their projects in the classroom. The assignment will be evaluated by using a rubric scheme, a rating scale, and/or a marking scheme. Öğrenme-Öğretme Yaşantıları
bolumler.temelKabuller: This theme includes the concept of ''life in nature and global problems with its components such as natural disaster prevention, preparedness and balancing; eco-systems; eco-tourism and responsible travel'' and it is assumed that it could be present in almost all languages, with some exceptions. It is assumed that a student in after prep year 12 of upper secondary school may know what natural disaster prevention, preparedness and balancing; eco-systems; eco-tourism and responsible travel mean in their as it is known that almost all people who start to learn a new language bring their pre-existing knowledge (in their own language) with them and transfer it to their new language learning context. However, they may not know how to say these things in a foreign language if this has not yet been covered in their existing curriculum. Fortunately, this existing knowledge in their own language can help them recognise, understand, and learn them more easily in a foreign language, in this case English. As they are students in after prep year 12 of upper secondary school, they are expected to know some basic vocabulary about ''life in nature and global problems'' and also some necessary structures in English from the previous themes and/or years. These grammar items and vocabulary are revised during the ''Revision Programme'' at the beginning of the year, and they can be used as a basis for learning the new vocabulary and grammatical items in the current theme, so that the new grammatical elements in the current theme can be learnt easily.
bolumler.onDegerlendirme: It is assumed that these students in after prep year 12 of upper secondary school are ready to learn the concept of ''life in nature and global problems with its components such as natural disaster prevention, preparedness and balancing; eco-systems; eco-tourism and responsible travel'' cognitively, affectively, and socially since it is appropriate to their age and language level. Therefore, a contextual poster or a large picture could be provided for the students to remember and practise the items that they are related and previously learnt so that they can discuss about the poster and/or the picture in pairs and write down what they remember. This session can help them revise all the related vocabulary and grammatical elements that they have already learnt from previous themes or from previous years as a preparatory practice. In this way, their performance can be evaluated in terms of how much they remember and how accurately they use these items to build their competence in the current theme. It can help the teacher decide what to emphasise, revise, and practise in order to facilitate the new vocabulary and grammatical items in the current theme. (Their performance can be evaluated by rubrics, a rating scale, and /or a marking scheme during these practices.).
bolumler.zenginlestirme: Objective: To discuss and answer questions related to ecotourism recovery, challenges, and the involvement of local communities in English by using the target vocabulary. Activity 1: Eco-Tourism Recovery In this activity, students watch a short video about a natural disaster (like an earthquake, tsunami, or hurricane) and how ecotourism helped with recovery. The video explains the actions taken to rebuild ecotourism, the challenges faced, and the role of local communities in the prevention and recovery process. After watching the video, students work in small groups to answer the comprehension questions, such as, ''What measures were taken to recover eco-tourism after the disaster? What challenges do eco-tourism destinations face after a natural disaster? What was the role of local communities in recovery?''. The groups discuss and answer the questions; the teacher asks each group to share their answers. After each group’s answers, the teacher provides feedback on the correct use of the language. Students reflect on their thoughts and feelings about the activity.
bolumler.destekleme: Objective: To identify natural disaster prevention, preparedness and balancing; ecosystems; ecotourism in English by using target vocabulary. Activity 1: In this activity, students review target vocabulary related to natural disaster prevention, preparedness, balancing ecosystems, ecotourism, and responsible travel using flashcards. The teacher introduces target vocabulary such as ''threat'', ''defence'', ''construct'', ''minimise'', ''aid'', ''sensitivity'', ''destination'', ''impact'', and ''conserve''. Then, the students complete sentences using the correct words from the Word Bank in a fillin- the-blanks activity. For instance, ''People should have taken some precautions to protect themselves from natural disasters''. This activity helps students understand the relationship between natural disaster preparedness, ecotourism, and responsible travel. Later, students read the sentences aloud, and the teacher provides feedback on correct use of target vocabulary and pronunciation. Students reflect on their thoughts and feelings about the activity.
